summary: Plugin docs normally live in the code file, but when several plugins share a file (filters, tests) or a module isn't Python, docs go in an adjacent file; since ansible-core 2.14 that can be YAML instead of Python.
questions: How do I document filters that are all defined in one Python file?
Can I use a YAML file to document a module written in another language?
Since when are adjacent YAML doc files supported?

answer_card.title: When to use adjacent documentation files
answer_card.answer_md: Use an adjacent doc file when several plugins share one file (filters, tests) or a module isn't written in Python. Since **ansible-core 2.14**, the adjacent file can be **YAML** instead of `.py`, using nearly the same structure in pure YAML.
